name: Smaller CC0 texture libraries (cgbookcase, 3DTextures.me) and ShareTextures' limits
licence_summary: cgbookcase: CC0, 100% free. 3DTextures.me: recent pages state CC0 for the free resolutions (higher resolutions on Patreon). ShareTextures: custom CC0 with restrictions (no automated downloads, no embedding in apps/add-ons, no redistribution without permission).
cautions: ShareTextures: an agent must not bulk-download or script downloads; fetch by hand only.
3DTextures.me Patreon-only resolutions are not covered by the free CC0 statement.
